title: Rare Fluctuations from Normally Hyperbolic Invariant Manifolds
summary: Freidlin--Wentzell theory converts weak-noise large deviations into a Hamiltonian variational problem. We study how a $k$-dimensional normally hyperbolic invariant manifold (NHIM) $N$ of the deterministic dynamics appears in this Hamiltonian system. Its zero-momentum copy $N_0=N\times\{0\}$ is invariant, but the Hamiltonian dynamics has $2k$ center directions near $N_0$: $k$ tangent to $N$ and $k$ conjugate covector directions.
